apod.explanation: Saturn vanishes when the Moon passes in front of it — an occultation visible in early 2025 from Greenland through central Europe to northern Africa. This fusion of three images from Sardinia, Italy, catches Saturn just before it disappeared; the bright dot nearby is the star 85 Aquarii, and the next such occultation comes in 2031.
apod.title: Saturn Behind the Moon

breaking.fact: Prices rose 0.4% in October (vs 0.3% expected) and core 0.3% for a third straight month; BLS published no 12-month rate after the 2025 shutdown wiped out Oct 2025 data. A December Fed hike is now near-certain — Gov. Waller had tied a 0.3% core print to a possible 50bp move.
breaking.headline: October CPI runs hot: +0.4% headline, +0.3% core — both above forecasts

breaking.fact: In the first readout from Monday's White House meeting with Qatar's PM, Trump said Tehran is 'talking very politely' and there is a 'good chance' of a deal — but the naval blockade and Operation Iron Gate stay, and Tehran disputes that talks exist.
breaking.headline: Trump says Iran war could end 'fairly soon'; new strikes 'quite unlikely'

breaking.fact: The Claude maker's Nasdaq listing (ticker ANT) is targeted for the week of Nov 16; investors have cut the valuation talk from ~$2T after Monday's sell-off, though no price range is set yet.

breaking.fact: Jason Leon Watford, 48, was taken into custody Monday after the cruise ship docked in Galveston one day into its voyage; he is held at Galveston County Jail on an FBI hold. The victim's identity has not been released.
breaking.headline: Suspect detained in MSC Seascape homicide probe after ship returns to Galveston

items.body: Maritime agencies say attacks on tankers rose sharply in October and remain at their highest rate since the conflict began. The IRGC's claim that 3-4 tankers hit mines Sunday is still unconfirmed; UKMTO verified one outbound tanker hit by an unidentified projectile 15 km NW of Khasab, Oman (Nov 8), crew safe.
items.headline: Tanker attacks at highest rate since conflict began, agencies say

items.body: Iranian state media reported US forces struck Qeshm Island over the weekend — unverified, with no US confirmation. Iran's Navy separately claims a 4th tanker was hit; Reuters could not confirm any of the strikes.
items.headline: Iranian media claim US struck Qeshm Island over the weekend

items.body: The Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted 2 ballistic and 2 cruise missiles targeting Riyadh and other regions Sunday; debris damaged several floors of the Aramco Tower, no casualties. The Khor Mor gas field in Iraqi Kurdistan was hit by a drone strike Nov 8 and reported dark.
items.headline: Houthi missiles reach Riyadh

items.body: Trump now says the war could end 'fairly soon' and renewed strikes are 'quite unlikely' — but the naval blockade and Operation Iron Gate stay in place, Rubio says no breakthrough is near, and Tehran disputes that talks exist. Day 1 of the proposal: the US lifts the blockade and releases frozen Iranian funds ($6-9B, figures differ); Day 2: Hormuz reopens and nuclear talks resume over the 60%-enriched stockpile (IAEA: 440.9 kg).
items.headline: Diplomacy: the two-day Qatar proposal

hormuz.stats: Traffic & shares (latest verified): EIA puts Hormuz oil flows at 4.9M bbl/day in Q2 2026, down from 21.6M in Q4 2025; the IEA estimates ~20M bbl/day transited in 2025, about a quarter of global seaborne oil trade. China takes ~42% and India ~13% of strait crude throughput; ~90% of Iran's oil exports go to China. The EIA warns vessel-tracking data have become less reliable during the conflict.

marketsNote: Monday's best day since April holds into Tuesday's open: futures are mixed after a hot October CPI (+0.4% headline, +0.3% core) — S&P 500 futures ~7,576 (flat), Dow futures +0.37%, Nasdaq-100 futures -0.40%. Oil extends Monday's slide (WTI ~$84.74, Brent ~$90.18) as Trump plays down new Iran strikes; the 10-year is near 4.9%.

space.body: NASA's Chandra X-ray Observatory caught the 'supernova impostor' AT 2016blu, 30 million light-years away, flaring 100x brighter in X-rays during a March 2026 outburst — evidence an unseen black hole or neutron star is siphoning gas off the giant star every ~113 days. Published in Astrophysical Journal Letters.
space.headline: Hidden companion may be fueling a giant star's 113-day outbursts

space.body: The rover's SuperCam laser detected chromium-bearing corundum — the mineral behind rubies — in three pale rocks near Jezero Crater's rim. No collectible gems, but the crystals hint at ancient heat and pressure on a planet with no plate tectonics. Published in Geophysical Research Letters.
space.headline: Perseverance finds ruby-family mineral on Mars

space.body: Hoag researchers found a blood RNA molecule, Tu-Stroma, that detected precancerous STIC lesions in 92.3% of women who had them and correctly cleared 98.2% of healthy women in validation — an eight-year international study published in Nature Medicine.
space.headline: Blood RNA signal may flag ovarian cancer before it turns invasive
